title: Animal Rescue
description: Package about Air Force Lt. Cols. John and Vicky Johnson, stationed at Cannon Air Force Base, volunteering with organizations in the Clovis, N.M. area rescuing stray animals.
keywords: puppies, N.M., Cannon Air Force Base, Clovis, Lt. Col. John Johnson, John Johnson, lt col vicky johnson, kittens, Vicky Johnson, rescue, animals

transcript.text: Airmen are encouraged to volunteer within their community.
Lieutenant Colonel John Johnson and Lieutenant Colonel Vicky Johnson take volunteering to the next level.
The pair work with organizations in the Southwest to find safe homes for stray cats and dogs in the Clovis, New Mexico area.
I think it's really important to stop the over-pet population in the area.
I knew it was terrible before we ever came here.
Just so many animals. I'd heard about it for forever.
So I just really wanted to be a part of it to stop that from happening.
The Johnson's are doing exactly that.
Over the past three and a half years they have rescued more than 700 pets in the Clovis community.
They are involved in all aspects of animal rescue from catching cats and dogs to daily care and finally finding the right home.
Before going to their new families, the animals are spayed or neutered with money from donations.
Donating money is not the only way volunteers help.
Many people help by donating time.
When I do volunteer work I try to find things that I'm interested in.
I love animals like, hello, just in here playing. I'm so cute.
The Johnson's cannot do this alone.
To help the animals contact Lieutenant Colonel Vicki Johnson at 478-718-5644.
Reporting from Cannon Air Force Base, I'm Airman First Class Jessica Felipe.
